Eclipses are powerful magical events. Often times those with the gift of prophecy are able to have powerful and euphoric visions of the future during these moments.

Yara was invited to the Eclipse Ball accompanying Adrithyr and his family, and she is present during the eclipse, during which she has a prophetic and horrifying vision.

"Hear me, mortals. The golden eyes of heaven have turned their gaze upon your world, apocalypse is coming. The Devourer awakens.

I see a vast crimson ocean, filled with royal blood. The Red King will bathe in its rewards, and be granted the gift of death, and disgrace. The sons of the dragon are rising from hell and falling from the sky.
The crown ripped in two, as he was...
The sins of a king, made flesh.

(As she speaks you hear faint voices, almost like those of Kairos, Bekarys, and Abagnale, chanting over and over "You didn't win, you didn't win, you didn't win.)

I see the Reckoner impaled upon his own sword, a deal with the devil, signed in the blood of the forsaken.
He does not shatter crowns, HE WILL SHATTER THE EARTH ITSELF, AND THE LAND SHALL BURN AND BE RAISED IN THE EYE OF HEAVEN! BEWARE! THAT TERRIBLE THING IN THE DARKNESS THAT MAKES YOU BUILD WALLS AND CARRY TORCHES! WHAT YOU FEAR HIDING IN THE DARKNESS IS NOT MONSTERS OR DEVILS! IT IS MANNNNNNNN!

In victory the golden sun rises, and sets, endlessly...
He is the only one who can save you, and the one who will destroy you. Beware, stories have no champions, and this tale ends in despair.
This is his story, his destiny, we are just pieces of something far greater, he will remind us of our insignificance.

I see golden eyes ablaze with the light of change, and death.
And in the end, as the reckoner falls, the fallen love will be reborn in golden rage."
